name: Saint-Cloud: l'Allée des Statues
note: versailles/road.ts: OSM's three walks of the Allée des Statues (bearing 84), the terrace in setts (owner, 2026-11-04: cobblestone), clipped yew cones between; statues' places left empty for the GLBs.

name: Saint-Cloud: le Grand Réservoir
note: versailles/road.ts: coping and railing round OSM's water (way/168492667, 176 x 76 m, bearing 106). Edge treatment unverified.

name: Saint-Cloud: the Lanterne's foundations (Rond de la Balustrade)
note: versailles/road.ts: the Lanterne de Démosthène's foundations on the round's lawn, off IGN's orthophoto (refs/versailles/lanterne); frame origin OSM's junction node. Replaces the guessed kerbed round and balustrade (2026-11-04).

name: Saint-Cloud: la grille de l'Île Monsieur
note: versailles/road.ts: on the park's east wall by the Parc nautique (OSM: lift gate 48.8345 2.22259). Name and place from the owner's Google map; look unverified.

name: Musée national de céramique (Manufacture de Sèvres)
note: versailles/road.ts: Laudin, 1876, three levels, pedimented middle pavilion (Monumentum); the front to the Seine. Brick and stone a guess.

name: Hôtel de ville de Sèvres
note: versailles/road.ts: on the Grande Rue (the old N10); supersedes its civic.json entry. Not identified in a photograph.

name: Mairie de Chaville
note: versailles/road.ts: 1909, in its park, toward the Avenue Roger-Salengro (the old N10); a clock belfry over the front.

name: Mairie de Ville-d'Avray
note: versailles/road.ts: two storeys, the kit's mairie.

name: Fontaine du Roi (Ville-d'Avray)
note: versailles/road.ts: the stone fountain pavilion; OSM's 4 x 3 m building.

name: Église Saint-Nicolas-Saint-Marc (Ville-d'Avray)
note: Louis XVI, consecrated 1791: the kit's classical front (pediment). Corot's paintings inside. Its low flank tower not drawn.

name: Pavillon de Breteuil (BIPM)
note: versailles/road.ts: lidar 10-11 m ranges, the middle 13-14 m (refs/versailles/breteuil); render, two storeys, low slate hip (en.wikipedia photo). The east front over the old Grand Parterre's slope.

name: Saint-Cloud: le fronton du Palais de l'Industrie (pedestal)
note: versailles/road.ts: the pedestal of Élias Robert's group (the figures are the GLB pipeline's); sizes from the en.wikipedia photo scaled by the 6.5 m group and IGN lidar (refs/versailles/fronton). Front to the south assumed.
